provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code over Z_341: H_X=[circ(a)|circ(b)], H_Z=[circ(b)^T|circ(a)^T], with b=a(x^8) (Frobenius power q=8). Same a-support as the board leader codes/682-172-78.json (q=4 there); a is a weight-14 element of the degree-86 divisor ideal of x^341-1 over GF(2), and any power-of-2 Frobenius image of a (q=2,4,8,16,...) stays in the same ideal, which is why multiple q choices land on the same distance here. This entry ties the existing leader exactly (d=78, kd^2/n unchanged) rather than improving it -- submitted as an independently verified alternate construction at the same point, not a record claim. Z witness derived from the X witness via the standard permutation symmetry for abelian/cyclic GB codes (negate index mod 341 within each block, swap blocks), then independently re-verified against this entry's own H_X/H_Z.
provenance.notes: Possible equivalence disclosed, not excluded: a local run of validate_candidate() flags this entry's structural (Weisfeiler-Leman) signature as matching codes/682-172-76.json (a different, independently authored entry at the same n,k with d=76), not codes/682-172-78.json directly -- despite this entry's a-support being identical to the leader's and its distance tying the leader's exactly. H_X and H_Z are distinct matrices (b=a(x^8) here vs a(x^4) for the leader); whether this constitutes a genuinely new code or a structural equivalence class member is left to the verifier's own signature, exactly as disclosed for 682-172-76.json itself.
